搜索命中了 3 条高价值帖子——尤其**「给 30+ 专业服务公司做自动化后，同样 5 个任务反复出现」**。抓这两条完整正文。

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 400000, "code": "
const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
 "function get(u){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'application/rss+xml'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "function clean(s){return s.replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\\s+/g,' ');}",
 "(async function(){",
 " const q='https://www.reddit.com/search.rss?q='+encodeURIComponent('automating workflows 30 professional services firms five tasks')+'&sort=relevance&t=year';",
 " const r=await get(q);",
 " console.log('status', r.status, 'len', r.body.length);",
 " const es=r.body.split('<entry>').slice(1);",
 " for(const e of es){",
 " const t=/<title>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/.exec(e);",
 " const ct=/<content type=\"html\">([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/content>/.exec(e);",
 " const title=t?clean(t[1]):'?';",
 " const body=ct?clean(ct[1]):'';",
 " if(/same 5 tasks|five tasks|30 professional/i.test(title+body)){",
 " console.log('\\n========== '+title+' ==========');",
 " console.log(body.substring(0,5000));",
 " }",
 " }",
 " await new Promise(function(x){setTimeout(x,100000)});",
 " const q2='https://www.reddit.com/search.rss?q='+encodeURIComponent('multiple clients hire me build this simple automation linkedin jobs')+'&sort=relevance&t=year';",
 " const r2=await get(q2);",
 " const es2=r2.body.split('<entry>').slice(1);",
 " for(const e of es2){",
 " const t=/<title>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/.exec(e);",
 " const ct=/<content type=\"html\">([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/content>/.exec(e);",
 " const title=t?clean(t[1]):'?';",
 " const body=ct?clean(ct[1]):'';",
 " if(/multiple clients|linkedin jobs/i.test(title)){",
 " console.log('\\n========== '+title+' ==========');",
 " console.log(body.substring(0,3500));",
 " }",
 " }",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-pain2.cjs", content: js });

const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch full text of automation pain-point posts", timeoutMs: 350000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 14000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));
